_meta.description: Merged DRI values for 14 minerals: all values machine-parsed from IOM/NCBI/MSD/NAS/LPI sources at finest available granularity. All UL/UL_unit/UL_note machine-verified. 0 manual_transcription, 0 manual source file dependencies.
input_files: data/dri-p-mg-ul-parsed.json (P/Mg UL, LPI based on IOM 1997)

stats.granularity: finest available per source: Ca 22 groups (IOM 2011), P/Mg 22 groups each (IOM 1997 via NCBI), trace minerals 16 groups each (MSD Professional), Na/K 22 groups each (NAS 2019)
stats.pregnancy_breastfeeding: split into teen (14-18yr), adult 19-30yr, adult 31-50yr subgroups — matching IOM/NAS source granularity

nutrients.name: Chromium
nutrients.note: Essentiality questioned by recent research (Vincent, J Nutr 2017). Values are AI.

nutrients.name: Calcium
nutrients.ul_note: Adults 19–50 yr. UL 2000 mg for adults >50 yr.

nutrients.name: Phosphorus
nutrients.ul_note: Adults 19–70 yr: 4000 mg. Adults >70 yr: 3000 mg. Source: Linus Pauling Institute, based on IOM 1997.

nutrients.name: Magnesium
nutrients.ul_note: UL applies to supplemental magnesium only, not food sources. Source: Linus Pauling Institute, based on IOM 1997.

nutrients.name: Potassium
nutrients.ul_note: ND — not determined. NAS 2019: insufficient evidence to establish UL for potassium.
nutrients.note: AI values from NAS 2019 DRI for Sodium and Potassium. No UL or CDRR established for potassium.

nutrients.name: Sodium
nutrients.ul_note: ND — not determined. No UL for sodium. CDRR (Chronic Disease Risk Reduction) replaces UL: 2300 mg/day for adults ≥14 yr; lower for children.
nutrients.note: AI values from NAS 2019 DRI for Sodium and Potassium. CDRR (not UL) is the relevant upper intake benchmark for sodium.
